title: От Луки 18 — Luke 18
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: В одном городе был ___, который не боялся Бога и не стыдился людей.
cases.translation: There was a judge in a certain city who didn't fear God and didn't respect people.
cases.explain: Судья is the subject of the existential был ("there was a judge") — nominative, the dictionary form.
The preposition от ("from") always takes the genitive → противника.

cases.sentence: А сборщик налогов, стоя вдали, не смел даже глаз к ___ поднять, но бил себя в грудь.
cases.translation: But the tax collector, standing far off, didn't even dare lift his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast.
cases.explain: The preposition к ("toward") takes the dative → небу.

cases.sentence: «...то я разрешу ее ___, иначе она замучит меня своими просьбами».
cases.translation: "...then I will grant her case, or else she will wear me out with her pleading."
cases.explain: Тяжба is the direct object of the transitive verb разрешу ("I will resolve/grant") → accusative тяжбу.

cases.sentence: Говорю вам, что именно этот человек пошел домой оправданным перед ___, а не первый.
cases.translation: I tell you, it was this man who went home justified before God, not the other.
cases.explain: The preposition перед ("before, in front of") always takes the instrumental → Богом.

cases.sentence: Он без промедления защитит их, но когда Сын Человеческий придет, то найдет ли Он веру на ___?
cases.translation: He will defend them without delay, but when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?
cases.explain: На meaning a static location ("on the earth", no motion) takes the prepositional → земле.

cases.sentence: Когда Иисус подходил к Иерихону, у ___ сидел слепой и просил милостыню.
cases.translation: As Jesus was approaching Jericho, a blind man sat by the road, begging.
cases.explain: The preposition у ("by, next to") takes the genitive → дороги.

cases.sentence: Он будет отдан ___, те будут глумиться над ним, унижать его, плевать в него, бичевать и затем убьют.
cases.translation: He will be handed over to the Gentiles; they will mock him, mistreat him, spit on him, scourge him, and then kill him.
cases.explain: Отдан ("handed over") governs the dative of the recipient → язычникам.

reading.ru: В одном городе был судья, который не боялся Бога и не стыдился людей.
reading.question: What kind of judge lived in the city in Jesus' parable?
options: A judge who feared neither God nor people
A judge known for his fairness
A judge who was also a priest
A judge who refused to hear any cases
reading.correct: A judge who feared neither God nor people
reading.explain: The text says there was a judge who didn't fear God and didn't respect people.

reading.ru: «Пусть я Бога не боюсь и с людьми не считаюсь, но так как эта вдова постоянно надоедает мне, то я разрешу ее тяжбу, иначе она замучит меня своими просьбами».
reading.question: Why did the judge finally decide to grant the widow's request?
options: Because she kept pestering him and he wanted her to stop
Because he suddenly began to fear God
Because the widow paid him money
Because his advisers told him to
reading.correct: Because she kept pestering him and he wanted her to stop
reading.explain: The judge admits he doesn't fear God or respect people, but grants her request because she keeps bothering him and might wear him out.

reading.ru: Два человека пришли во двор храма помолиться. Один из них был фарисей, а другой сборщик налогов.
reading.question: Who were the two men who went to the temple to pray?
options: A Pharisee and a tax collector
reading.correct: A Pharisee and a tax collector
reading.explain: Two men went up to the temple courtyard to pray — one was a Pharisee, the other a tax collector.

reading.ru: А сборщик налогов, стоя вдали, не смел даже глаз к небу поднять, но бил себя в грудь и говорил, — Боже, будь милостив ко мне, грешнику!
reading.question: How did the tax collector behave while praying?
options: He wouldn't even look up to heaven and beat his chest, asking for mercy
He stood at the front and prayed loudly
He refused to pray at all
reading.correct: He wouldn't even look up to heaven and beat his chest, asking for mercy
reading.explain: Standing far off, he wouldn't even lift his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, "God, be merciful to me, a sinner!"

reading.ru: Но Иисус подозвал их к себе и сказал, «Пусть дети приходят ко Мне, не запрещайте им, потому что Царство Божие принадлежит таким, как они.
reading.question: What did Jesus say when the disciples tried to stop people bringing children to him?
options: Let the children come to me; the Kingdom of God belongs to such as them
Children must wait until they are older
He said nothing and let the disciples turn them away
reading.correct: Let the children come to me; the Kingdom of God belongs to such as them
reading.explain: Jesus called the children to himself and said not to forbid them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as they.

reading.ru: «Благой учитель, что мне делать, чтобы наследовать вечную жизнь?»
reading.question: What did the rich ruler ask Jesus?
options: What must I do to inherit eternal life?
How can I become ruler of Israel?
Why do you heal on the Sabbath?
reading.correct: What must I do to inherit eternal life?
reading.explain: The ruler asked, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

reading.ru: Продай все, что у тебя есть, и раздай деньги бедным, и тогда у тебя будет сокровище на небесах.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the rich ruler he still lacked?
options: He told him to sell everything and give the money to the poor
He told him to fast more often
He told him to become a Pharisee
reading.correct: He told him to sell everything and give the money to the poor
reading.explain: Jesus said, "Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor, then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me."

reading.ru: легче верблюду пройти сквозь игольное ушко, чем богатому войти в Божье царство.
reading.question: What image did Jesus use to describe how hard it is for a rich person to enter God's Kingdom?
options: A camel passing through the eye of a needle
A ship passing through a narrow strait
A bird flying through a storm
reading.correct: A camel passing through the eye of a needle
reading.explain: Jesus said it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich person to enter God's Kingdom.

reading.ru: Он будет отдан язычникам, те будут глумиться над ним, унижать его, плевать в него, бичевать и затем убьют. Но на третий день он воскреснет.
reading.question: What did Jesus predict would happen to him in Jerusalem?
options: He would be handed over to the Gentiles, mocked, mistreated, and killed, then rise on the third day
He would be arrested by the Pharisees and released
He would build a new temple
reading.correct: He would be handed over to the Gentiles, mocked, mistreated, and killed, then rise on the third day
reading.explain: Jesus told the twelve he would be handed over to the Gentiles, mocked, mistreated, spat on, scourged, and killed, but would rise on the third day.

reading.ru: Слепой сразу же обрел зрение и пошел за Иисусом, славя Бога, и весь народ, увидев это, восхвалял Бога.
reading.question: What did the blind man do after Jesus healed him?
options: He asked for money before leaving
He went to tell the Pharisees
reading.explain: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God, and all the people, seeing it, praised God.
